name: Intercostal Neuralgia
definition: Neuropathic pain arising from one or more intercostal nerves, producing band-like chest or abdominal pain after trauma, surgery, zoster or other nerve injury.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical after exclusion of visceral and spinal causes; imaging is cause-directed.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Thoracic pain should not be labeled neuralgia before serious cardiopulmonary/visceral disease is excluded.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Parshva-shoola/Vata neuralgic phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Neuropathic pain arising from one or more intercostal nerves, producing band-like chest or abdominal pain after trauma, surgery, zoster or other nerve injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, major trauma, suspected infection, pathological fracture, neurovascular compromise or other listed red flags.
